name: Stack Scroll Reveal
description: A pinned deck of four case-study cards that scroll-scrub: each card grows as the front one peels away with a perspective tilt. Copy-plus-image cards in deepening brand shades over a large accent headline, with a lerp-smoothed drive and an --u fluid-layout engine.
interactions: section pins for 30vh (S = 152 + 0.3*vh from the section top), track height 152px + 570vh
per card N: grow scale base -> base*boost with a small lift over [S, S + N*110vh]; front card exits translateY(-736*u) + rotateX(15deg) over its own 100vh window (verbatim data-base/boost/lift/peek)
scrubbed scroll value is lerp-smoothed (factor 0.12); dual drive of a rAF loop + a passive scroll listener
--u = stack width / 1000 scales the fluid layout; container < 810px flips cards to a stacked column (JS toggles wssr-narrow on container width, not viewport)
prefers-reduced-motion: the scrub is skipped entirely and the deck lays out as a readable stacked list
